evals.title: English maintenance request selects the Japanese Skill
evals.prompt: The English authoring document now requires a Japanese-reference update before merging. Please synchronize docs/ja/authoring.md with docs/authoring.md, preserving its condition and deadline.

files.docs/authoring.md: If an English requirement changes, maintainers must update its Japanese reference before merging the pull request.
files.docs/ja/authoring.md: 英語の要件が変更された場合、保守者は pull request をマージする前に日本語参考訳を更新してもよい。

baseline_files.docs/authoring.md: If an English requirement changes, maintainers may update its Japanese reference before merging the pull request.
baseline_files.docs/ja/authoring.md: 英語の要件が変更された場合、保守者は pull request をマージする前に日本語参考訳を更新してもよい。

assertions.text: The completed event stream shows successful reads of the repository candidate and companion before editing, with no personal same-name Skill read.
Only the Japanese reference changes; it preserves the stronger obligation, condition, and pre-merge deadline in natural Japanese.

evals.title: Issue authoring does not select reference maintenance
evals.prompt: Draft a Japanese body for an Issue titled 'Improve setup guidance'. The Summary is 'Clarify the setup steps for new users.' No repository file has changed. Do not edit files.

assertions.text: Answer the Issue-body request without applying maintain-japanese-references or editing repository files.
